adjustment.analysis: The baseline median is 7.7. The back-to-school season has a noise-adjusted uplift of x1.26 from 9 past occurrences, with recent evidence (2026-08-03) showing x2.21. The price is unchanged, and no promotion is planned. Past promotions show no lasting lift, and the post-promo dip is noise-adjusted to x1.0. The classical uplift model's x1.26 is supported by historical event data and recent sales. No other drivers (e.g., price change, closure) are present. Confidence is medium due to limited past event repetitions and noise in single-week spikes.
